leadText: Mikey (Japanese: タイチ Taichi) is a character of the day who appeared in The Battling Eevee Brothers.
plainText:
Mikey (Japanese: タイチ Taichi) is a character of the day who appeared in The Battling Eevee Brothers.

==In animation==
===Pokémon the Series===
All of Mikey's brothers fought over how Mikey should evolve his . Despite the fact that all of his brothers wanted to see him train an Eeveelution as well, he preferred keeping his Eevee just the way it was. However, he did not have the courage to tell his older brothers this. Eventually, after some advice from , who related to Mikey since she is the youngest of four sisters, he decided to try anyway. His brothers eventually came to accept Mikey's choice after witnessing Eevee battle and emerge victorious.

====Pokémon====
 

====Voice actors====
 

==In the manga==
 ]]
===The Electric Tale of Pikachu===
Mikey appeared in To Evolve or Not to Evolve, That Is the Question!. His desire was to join the Knights of the E Stone, just like his brothers, but was denied due to him not having evolved his Eevee. defeated Pyro and Rainer for him, but Sparky demanded to battle Mikey himself. During their battle, Ash took a time-out in order to use a TM to teach Eevee , allowing it to defeat Sparky's and thus allow Mikey to join the Knights of the E Stone.

In Welcome to the Big Leagues, Mikey was seen watching the Indigo Plateau Pokémon League on his television.

====Pokémon====
 

==Trivia==
Mikey's hair resembles the fluffy part of an Eevee's neck that looks like a collar.
